Exposure to Biological Contaminants in the Residential Indoor Environment and the Development of Respiratory Allergy and Asthma in Children
PI: Bert Brumekreef, Ph.D.
Wageningen Agricultural University
Wageningen, The Netherlands

The research team will investigate the role of mold and bacterial components in the development of respiratory allergy and asthma in a cohort of 800 high-risk children. Te investigators will look at the relationship between home characteristics and microbial exposure during the first year of life.
